LanguageData.AT_Setting_EnableAutoTranslation_Tooltip: When off, no network requests are made at all - only previously cached translations are applied. Useful when you are offline or want to stop translating. Fully applied after a game restart.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_AutoTranslateNewMods: Automatically translate newly added mods (default: On)
LanguageData.AT_Setting_AutoTranslateNewMods_Tooltip: When off, mods added after this point are excluded from translation by default. You can enable them manually in the Target Mods tab.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_TargetLanguageOverride: Target language override (empty = follow game language):
LanguageData.AT_Setting_TargetLanguageOverride_Toolti: Manually set the translation target language instead of the game's active language. Enter a language NAME in English (e.g. "Latvian") or pick one from the dropdown. Leave empty to detect automatically.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_ShowOriginal: Show original text on hover (default: Off):
LanguageData.AT_Setting_ShowOriginal_Tooltip: When hovering over translated text, the original text will be displayed. Due to system limitations, this feature is not available for all translations.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_EnableLanguageDetection_Toolt: Automatically detects if text is already in the target language and skips translation. This prevents re-translating content that's already in Korean/Japanese/Chinese etc. when stored in the English folder. Recommended to keep enabled.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_Note: Note: Changes to the settings below require a game restart
LanguageData.AT_Setting_RequiresAPIKey: This translation engine requires an API key.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_RequiresAPIKey_Tooltip: To use multiple API keys in rotation, separate them with commas (,).
LanguageData.AT_Message_LanguageNotSupported: This translator does not support your current language. Please select a different one.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_NoModelFound: No models found. Please verify your API key.
LanguageData.AT_Message_NoModelsFound: No models found. Please check your API key and base URL.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_ManualModelEntry: Or enter a model name manually:
LanguageData.AT_Setting_LibreTranslateKeyNotice: Note: the official libretranslate.com instance now requires a paid API key (portal.libretranslate.com). Self-hosted instances need no key.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_DeepLFreeKeyOnPro: This looks like a DeepL Free key (ends with ":fx"). Please select the "DeepL" translator instead of "DeepL Pro".
LanguageData.AT_Setting_DeepLProKeyOnFree: This looks like a DeepL Pro key. Please select the "DeepL Pro" translator instead of "DeepL".
LanguageData.AT_Setting_ClaudeCodeNotice: Uses the locally installed Claude Code CLI with its own login (subscription). No API key is required, but the CLI must be installed and logged in.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_ClaudeCodePath: Path to the CLI executable (empty = "claude" on PATH):
LanguageData.AT_Setting_NoTranslatorError: Translator not found. Please check settings.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_ResetDefCache: Reset all Def caches (if some items are not translated)
LanguageData.AT_Status1: Translation is in progress. You can continue playing normally.
LanguageData.AT_Status2: Translation complete! It's recommended to reset Def caches or restart the game for full application.
LanguageData.AT_Status_NetworkPaused: Paused - network unreachable. Will retry automatically.
LanguageData.AT_Message_NetworkPaused: Auto Translation: network unreachable - translation paused. Will retry automatically.
LanguageData.AT_Message_NetworkResumed: Auto Translation: network recovered - translation resumed.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_WhiteList: Select mods to translate (applied in real-time)
LanguageData.AT_Message_RetranslateFailed: Cannot retranslate while translation is in progress.
LanguageData.AT_Message_ResetTranslationCache: Translation cache deleted. Please restart the game to begin translation again.
LanguageData.AT_Message_WhiteList_Failed: Translation is in progress and cannot be applied in real-time. Please retry after translation completes, or restart the game.
LanguageData.AT_Message_TestFailed: Test failed. You may have reached the API request limit, or your API key/model may be incorrect.
LanguageData.AT_Message_RestartWork: Restarting translation... (To completely redo, delete the cache first, then restart)
LanguageData.AT_Message_RestartFailed: Restart failed. Please verify your API key and model.
LanguageData.AT_Message_FailedToGetModels: Failed to retrieve models. Please check your API key:
LanguageData.AT_Setting_EnableBatchTranslation_Toolti: Translate multiple texts in a single API call for better performance. Only available for AI model translators (GPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.). Can improve translation speed by 5-10x.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_BatchSize_Tooltip: Number of tokens to collect before sending a batch request. Higher values = fewer API calls but slower individual responses. Recommended: 1500-3000.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_RequestTimeout_Tooltip: How long to wait for one API response before giving up. Cloud APIs usually answer within 30s; local LLMs (LM Studio, Ollama) often need 120-300s, especially with large batch sizes.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_Editor_RestartRequired: Changes will be applied after game restart.
LanguageData.AT_Gist_DownloadLabel: Download shared translations (Gist URL or ID):
LanguageData.AT_Gist_MergeInfo: Entries that differ from your local translations
LanguageData.AT_Gist_NoDifferences: No differences from your local translations.
LanguageData.AT_BulkReplace_FilterTooltip: Filter entries by Mod ID or original text. Supports regex (e.g., "modA|modB" to match multiple mods)
LanguageData.AT_BulkReplace_FindTooltip: Pattern to find in translated text. Use regex for advanced matching (e.g., "쥐족|rat-kin")
LanguageData.AT_BulkReplace_ReplaceTooltip: Text to replace matches with. Use $1, $2, etc. for regex capture groups
LanguageData.AT_BulkReplace_NoMatches: No matches found. Adjust your filters and try again.
LanguageData.AT_BulkReplace_Error: Error occurred during bulk replace. Check logs for details.
